empty.body: Jobs land here with how well they match your profile, their stage and the next step, so nothing slips. Search the job boards now, or add a job by its link.

new.invalid: Paste a link that starts with https://.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.heading: {{title}} · {{company}}
prepare.lead: What a CV for this job is based on: facts read on the company’s own website, and what the posting says. Nothing comes from a model’s memory.

site.label: {{company}}’s website
site.hint: Its own site, not a job board. Only the address is kept, once, for every job there.

prepare.readLead: Reads the posting and the company’s own website (that site only, where robots.txt allows) and makes the facts: one AI call, reused for 30 days. Then one more compares the job with your profile.
prepare.readingLead: Reading {{company}}’s pages, then comparing the job with your profile. This takes a few seconds.
prepare.noFacts: Nothing about {{company}} could be quoted from its pages.

facts.title: What {{company}}’s own pages say
facts.count_one: {{count}} fact, each with the page’s own words.
facts.count_other: {{count}} facts, each with the page’s own words.

pages.line_one: Read {{count}} page on {{date}}: {{pages}}. Reused until {{until}}, for every job at this company.
pages.line_other: Read {{count}} pages on {{date}}: {{pages}}. Reused until {{until}}, for every job at this company.
pages.blocked_one: {{count}} page was left alone: the website asks robots not to read it.
pages.blocked_other: {{count}} pages were left alone: the website asks robots not to read them.
pages.dropped_one: {{count}} fact was left out: its quote isn’t on the page it cites.
pages.dropped_other: {{count}} facts were left out: their quotes aren’t on the pages they cite.

wants.title: What this job wants most
wants.pending: Read about the company to see what the job wants most.
wants.noText: The posting has no text to read.
wants.none: Nothing the posting asks for could be quoted.

questions.lead: Asked only where your profile is thin for what this job wants. An answer reaches your profile only when you keep it.
questions.goesToLatest: This question names no position, so your answer goes on your most recent one: {{role}}.
questions.noPosition: Add a position to your profile first: an answer needs one to go on.
questions.dontHaveHint: “No” is a good answer: {{skill}} stays off your CVs and isn’t asked about again.
questions.wentToLatest: Taken from your answer, for your most recent position: {{role}}.
questions.nothing: Nothing in that answer could be kept as a fact.
questions.dropped_one: {{count}} line was left out: the checks couldn’t trace it to your words.
questions.dropped_other: {{count}} lines were left out: the checks couldn’t trace them to your words.

draft.title: Draft the CV
draft.lead: Next: the CV is drafted from these facts, your profile and your answers, and every line is checked against them.

prepare.costLine: Reading a company: one AI call, about {{read}}, reused for 30 days. Comparing the job: one call, about {{analysis}}. Each answer: one small call, about {{answer}}. Nothing runs in the background.

errors.invalid_site: That isn’t a website address. Write it starting with https://.
errors.site_not_allowed: That address can’t be read. Use the company’s public website.
errors.site_unreachable: The company’s website can’t be reached right now. Check the address, or try again later.
errors.robots_disallows: The company’s website asks robots not to read it, so nothing was read.
errors.no_pages_readable: None of the company’s pages had text to read.
errors.company_reads_daily_cap: You’ve read 20 companies today. Reading continues tomorrow.
errors.company_unknown: This opportunity has no company name yet. Type it in first.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI isn’t set up on this server, so nothing can be read.
errors.ai_daily_limit_reached: You’ve reached today’s AI limit. It continues tomorrow.
errors.ai_budget_reached: You’ve reached your AI spending limit. It continues when the limit resets.
errors.ai_failed: The AI couldn’t answer this time. Nothing was lost; try again.
